name: PointOps2 CUDA Kernels
definition: A collection of CUDA kernels for point cloud operations including KNN query, furthest point sampling, grouping, interpolation, subtraction, aggregation, attention mechanisms, and relative position encoding, exposed via PyTorch C++ extension.
summary: PointOps2 CUDA Kernels are GPU-accelerated PyTorch operations that compute element-wise feature differences between neighbors and reference points, distinct from aggregation or search methods.
